content.short: We democratize smart contracts by turning Plutus code into simple online forms.
content.description: Our mission is to lower the barrier to entry for web3 communities and individuals to interact with smart contracts. We wrap smart contracts in an easy to use interface to provide a robust and no code solution for people to create, manage, and execute smart contracts. We also provide tools to Cardano communities looking to operate as DAOs. We are part of a handful of projects and initiatives in the ecosystem. Clarity Protocol: A DAO Tooling Protocol Create and manage DAOs without writing any code. Establish governance rules and execute votes on-chain.
